data.narrative:
Dronamics is a Series A autonomous drone company founded by Svilen and Konstantin Rangelov, competing in the Drones & Autonomous sector alongside eight private peers including Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in this subsector, limiting benchmark depth.

The valuation analysis employs stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given Dronamics' Series A positioning. Using total raised of $43.2M as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier standard for Series A-to-next-stage progression yields $86.4M. A peer-median approach was not applied; while five same-sector peers exist, insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints with similar valuation tiers precluded reliable median calculation without introducing sector-wide distortion.

The triangulated range is $73M to $99M, centered on $86M. This range reflects the single applicable method and incorporates reasonable variance bounds around the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for this particular subsector—aerospace autonomous systems may command different investor step-up expectations than broader software or hardware—and the absence of direct peer pricing validation. Until additional Series A or Series B comparables in autonomous logistics become available, or until market data on Dronamics' specific unit economics and market traction emerges, this valuation carries elevated sensitivity to assumptions around financing velocity and investor appetite in the space.
